verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing is a subscription and invoicing platform, not an AI agent or MCP client, so plugging external MCP servers into it is a wrong-axis question for this kind of product. The only MCP evidence is Stripe's own MCP server, which lets outside agents call the Stripe API. That is the server role and does not show the product consuming other servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
